P182

Summary

/home/ftk3187/github/PSED/psed_v2/kb/reports/P182.summary.txt

P182: 7 calls (the recipe re-fill, gemini-3.8-flash, approved at the cost line; made $0.12); every other step 0 calls. Two stops on the
way (step 1: 33 values without a found quote; step 3: T6 2119 -> 2101), each settled by the user's decisions below. Final: no drop
except the accepted yim22 merge; T6 2119 -> 2125.

1. recipe_fill.py reads every text element (abstract, headings, paragraphs, captions, table cells); the section selection deleted (in
   process_mode_fill.job, which both fills use). --refill: papers with a null field after P181 = yli18, yim20, ela03, gre23, art19,
   gao15, wer21 (7; mat22, gor03, zou23, mat23 none null; hei24, yim22 no run). Contract (user, a): compile.recipe_fill, the importer,
   sets a value to null and lists it when its quote is null (30: process_mode thermal of yim20 12, ela03 14, gre23 4) or not found (yli18
   carrier_gas 2); the response schema makes each quote a required string (no new call). Shared quote check (user, b): compile.quote_found
   for step d and the importer: own texts (contiguous, else P140 token order: 12 records), else a substring of the paper's elements in
   element order, evidence = the elements spanned (ela03 carrier_gas: s3.p26;s3.p27). 27 pass-1 records were quote_not_found in P181 and
   are found now (11 of them in another element). User decisions (history.csv kind recipe_field, applied after the fill): yli18
   process_mode null; yli18 carrier_gas n2 (its quote joins s8.p21 and s8.p24 across two caption paragraphs, which the rule does not find).
   Accepted changes: yli18 reactants tma / ticl4 / h2o, yim20 carrier n2 (12), gre23 run_test dez, art19 reactant_B o_atom -> o2 (8).
2. Qualifier scopes: every key of ontology.yaml qualifiers has applies_to (18 entry lists, 5 any: kind, stat, between, n, x; 3 unit: mode,
   specimen_class, structure_class); stage = category test_structure + roughness + film_thickness, ratio = gas_flow_rate (user); widened by
   the gold's uses (user, step 3): level + coated_aspect_ratio, gas + molar_mass / molecule_diameter, reference and species + film_density,
   surface + reaction_stoichiometry, stage + film_thickness. 2a: the 38 hand lists removed, each entry's keys derived
   (export.entry_qualifiers): 15 difference rows, each with its reason; CODEBOOK prints them on the entry row and applies_to in section e;
   form.json one rule per scoped key; export --check 19 / 19. 2b: the per-case table first (P181's 1444 facts with qualifiers, 2312 key
   rows; the 445 of P181 section 7 marked): 471 removals expected, all logged; 78 logged outside the table (61 on records P181 had already
   dropped, 12 species the symbol-species step gives a model / definition / cited record of a quantity outside the species scope, 5 on
   elements whose P181 fact merged). Removed in all: 558 (structure_class 114, species 82, stage 61, mode 60, over 46, specimen_class 42,
   relative_to 28, position 24, phase 23, ratio 20, element 14, level 11, basis 8, step 7, by 4, gas 4, reference 4, surface 2, origin 2,
   reference_element 1, definition 1). Records recovered: 0 (P181's qualifier refusals were null qualifiers under form rule 1).
3. Step 3 (user): the symbol-species step reads model / definition / cited records only, never by quantity; its own-element test reads
   the text through normalize() (gre23 s9.p4 showed the miss: '$\text{H}_2\text{O}$' -> h2o). Its outcomes against P181: 106 rows changed
   (derived 33 and settings 26 no longer read; e.g. art19's derived r keep their own species, P179's o_atom correction gone; gor03 eq7 Pt
   loses hf_nme2_4; yli18 d_A from the definition instead of a conflict). yim22 fig6.cap / s15.p4 merge accepted (open_decisions.csv:
   model_initial_boundary_value_qualifier). Scores vs P181: T6 2119 -> 2125 (6 rows, all quotes now found across elements: mat22 eq1,
   ela03 x3, yim22 s13.p6, mat23 s10.p12); definition +1, derived +1, claim +3, model 146 -> 145 (the accepted yim22 merge).
   binding_regression 798 / 798; audits 1-5 PASS; export --check 19 / 19; cards 0 errors. yli18 s8.p24: all 8 rows with their step.
4. P182.recipes.csv (user): one row per pass-0 run (114; 62 run units derived from curves left out: zou23 60, mat23 2), every value with
   its element; 64 runs with material, reactant_A or reactant_B empty first (mat22 39 and mat23 13 without a material setting, art19 6,
   wer21 6 without reactants).

Recipes: one row per run (material, reactants, carrier, mode, steps, symbol species, settings without step, inherited conditions)

keymeaningapplies_toreason
definitionP108 (b): the definition an entry with definitions: a record follows (front_slope: normalized | thickness_per_cycle)definitions: presentmeaning: the definition an entry with definitions: a record follows; front_slope is the one entry with definitions
stepwhich step of the ALD cycle the value is about: the reactant_A / reactant_B pulse, the purge_A / purge_B, the plasma step, a hold_A / hold_B (static exposure), or none (not step-specific).pulse_time, purge_time, exposure, process_pressure, deposition_temperature, gas_flow_rate, plasma_power, pressure_rise, pressure_rate, time_to_maximum, gas_moles_per_cyclemeaning: the cycle step a value is about: the step times, exposure (form rule P158 1 requires a step on its settings), the conditions set per step (pressure, temperature, flows, plasma power: lists.py labels T (A dose), H2S flow (plasma)) and the per-step monitoring values
speciesthe substance a value is about (a species id): a reactant, a carrier or background gas, or a detected phasepulse_time, purge_time, partial_pressure, exposure, source_temperature, precursor_purity, initial_sticking_coefficient, recombination_probability, adsorption_equilibrium_constant, saturation_density, knudsen_number, mean_free_path, molar_mass, molecule_diameter, gas_phase_diffusion_coefficient, knudsen_diffusion_coefficient, effective_diffusion_coefficient, reactant_number_density, gas_moles_per_cycle, crystallite_size, phase, signal_intensitymeaning: the substance a value is about: a property or amount of a reactant or gas molecule, a delivery setting of one reactant (P181's step fill reads it on pulse_time / purge_time; lists.SUBSTANCE_SCOPED), or a detected phase
gasthe gas a value is about (a species id): the gas of a flow rate, of a plasma-feed share or of a partial pressuregas_flow_rate, plasma_gas_ratio, partial_pressure, annealing_temperaturemeaning: the gas of a flow rate, of a plasma-feed share or of a partial pressure; annealing_temperature by its list (the annealing atmosphere)
elementthe element a composition value counts (a chemical symbol): the numerator of an element_ratio, the element of an element_fraction, of an XPS signal or a binding energycomposition, element_fraction, element_ratio, signal_intensity, binding_energy, atoms_per_cyclemeaning: composition, element_ratio, element_fraction, XPS signal, binding energy; atoms_per_cycle counts atoms of one element
reference_elementSec. 18.3: the denominator atom of an element_ratioelement_ratiomeaning: the denominator atom of an element_ratio
phaseSec. 18.3: the phase a phase_fraction is ofphase_fractionmeaning: the phase a phase_fraction is of
positionwhere on the structure the value was taken: planar (the flat surface), top (the entrance), sidewall, bottom, entrance, plateau (the constant-thickness region), local, outside (outside the channel), interface.film_thickness, growth_per_cycle, step_coverage, surface_coverage, roughness, feature_widthmeaning: where on the structure the value was taken: thickness, growth, coverage and roughness, a structure dimension measured at a place; the other outputs' lists carry no position
referencethe thickness a normalized thickness is divided by: top, planar, plateau, entrance, maximum, assumed_saturation, stated (the authors give it), bulk.normalized_thickness, front_slopemeaning: the thickness a normalized thickness is divided by; front_slope by its list (slope of a normalized profile)
levelthe thickness fraction or front position that defines a penetration depth: 50%, 80%, front_start, front_end, maximum.penetration_depth, pressure_rise, dimensionless_distancemeaning: the fraction or front position that defines a penetration depth (also as a dimensionless distance); pressure_rise by its list (maximum)
basisthe aspect ratio a value is computed on: AR (geometric) or EAR (equivalent).coated_aspect_ratiomeaning: the aspect ratio a value is computed on; coated_aspect_ratio is the value computed on AR or EAR
surfacethe material of the surface a surface reaction happens on (a material id): a recombination probability on Al2O3recombination_probabilitymeaning: the surface a surface reaction happens on; its example is a recombination probability
kindpilot P16, P18: how a setting value is meant (a default inherited, an option not inherited, a target, a set point against a measured value); P131: estimated, a condition the paper estimates rather than sets or measuresanymeaning: how a setting value is meant (target, set point, default, option, estimated): a setting of any quantity (lists.py labels: film_thickness{kind=target}, deposition_temperature{kind=set_point}, process_pressure{kind=set_point})
bypilot: what a dimensionless distance is divided bydimensionless_distance, front_slopemeaning: what a dimensionless distance is divided by; front_slope is per unit of dimensionless distance
originpilot: where a distance is measured fromdistance, dimensionless_distance, penetration_depthmeaning: where a distance is measured from: the distance coordinates and a penetration depth (lists.py label penetration_depth{level=50%;origin=entrance})
stagepilot: before or after the deposition (porosity, channel height)unitthe user's P182 criterion: names the sample (before or after the deposition), not the value
statpilot P1: a spread fact's statisticanymeaning: a spread fact's statistic: a spread of any value
betweenpilot P1: what varies between the repeats of a spreadanymeaning: what varies between the repeats of a spread: a spread of any value
npilot P1: the number of repeatsanymeaning: the number of repeats of a spread: a spread of any value
relative_topilot P4: what a fraction is a fraction of; reactive_gases, all_gases: the denominator of a plasma feed ratio (P51)plasma_gas_ratio, mass_gain, porosity, phase_fraction, composition, element_fraction, atoms_per_cycle, coating_mass_fraction, shell_volume_fraction, fill_fractionmeaning: what a fraction is a fraction of: the fractions and ratios (its values all_atoms / metal_atoms are element-fraction denominators; lists.py label atoms_per_cycle{...;relative_to=...})
overpilot P5: what a per-cycle value is averaged overgrowth_per_cycle, atoms_per_cycle, saturation_growth_per_cycle, deposited_moles_per_cycle, gas_moles_per_cycle, exposuremeaning: what a per-cycle value is averaged over: the per-cycle quantities; exposure by lists.DERIVED exposure{over=run} (exposure per run)
modepilot P6: a measurement during or after the depositionunitthe user's P182 criterion: names the measurement (in situ or ex situ), not the value; check.py requires it on measurement activities
xpilot: the abscissa of a curveanymeaning: the abscissa of a curve: a curve of any quantity (facts.py: every points_ref fact carries x)
ratiopilot P17: the plasma_gas_ratio a keyed setting belongs tounitthe user's P182 criterion: names the experiment (the plasma_gas_ratio recipe a keyed setting belongs to, P17), not the value
specimen_classSec. 18.4 (P53): on an entity made by a deposition; a comparability axisunitthe user's P182 criterion: names the sample

+def qualifier_scopes(onto):
+    """P182 (user): each qualifier key's applies_to resolved: 'any' (every value fact), 'unit' (an attribute of a unit, never on a value
+    fact), or the sorted ids of the value entries (quantity, categorical) it names: an entry id, or a selector {field: value} matching
+    the entries ('present': the field is set). None when the key has no applies_to (export --check 19 refuses it)."""
+    vals = [e for e in onto["entries"] if e["type"] in ("quantity", "categorical")]
+    out = {}
+    for k, q in onto["qualifiers"].items():
+        a = q.get("applies_to")
+        if a is None or a in ("any", "unit"):
+            out[k] = a
+            continue
+        ids = set()
+        for x in (a if isinstance(a, list) else [a]):
+            if isinstance(x, dict):
+                ids |= {e["id"] for e in vals if all((bool(e.get(f)) if v == "present" else e.get(f) == v) for f, v in x.items())}
+            else:
+                ids.add(str(x))
+        out[k] = sorted(ids)
+    return out
+
+
+def entry_qualifiers(onto):
+    """P182 (user): a value entry's own qualifier keys, derived from the scopes (replacing the entries' hand lists): the keys whose
+    applies_to names it, in the order of ontology.yaml qualifiers. The any keys apply to every value fact and are not listed."""
+    sc = qualifier_scopes(onto)
+    return {e["id"]: [k for k, ids in sc.items() if isinstance(ids, list) and e["id"] in ids] for e in onto["entries"] if e["type"] in ("quantity", "categorical")}
+
+
+def scope_rules(onto):
+    """P182 (user): form.json allOf rules from the scopes, "$comment" "P182 scope <key>": a key whose applies_to names entries, on a record
+    whose quantity is one entry -> the entry is in the scope (other, null and a caveat's list of quantities are not checked); a unit key
+    -> no single quantity. The any keys have no rule. compile removes an out-of-scope key before form.json ('qualifier out of scope')."""
+    out = []
+    for k, ids in qualifier_scopes(onto).items():
+        if ids in ("any", None):
+            continue
+        allowed = [None] if ids == "unit" else ids + ["other", None]
+        out.append({"$comment": f"P182 scope {k}: " + ("a unit attribute, never on a value record" if ids == "unit" else f"applies to {', '.join(ids)}"),
+                    "if": {"properties": {"qualifiers": {"type": "object", "required": [k]}}, "required": ["qualifiers"]},
+                    "then": {"properties": {"quantity": {"anyOf": [{"enum": allowed}, {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/quantity_id"}}]}}}})
+    return out
+
+
